title: Wild Strawberry
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Thirty-six years after parasitic plants called Jinka overran Tokyo, infection means turning into a monster or being burned alive, and only the rich can afford a pollen vaccine. Poor young Kingo protects his sister Kayano; when she is infected by an unusual Jinka and the Flower Funeral Force moves to prune her, she ends up living inside Kingo, and he vows to make her human again. A seven-volume eco-horror action series.
life_message: Loyalty to family, even against a hostile system, is worth any cost.
